title: The Black & White Gallery at Red Dot Miami 2026
location: Mana Wynwood, Miami, FL (during Miami Art Week / Art Basel)
looking_for: Strictly black-and-white photography (all subjects/styles, min 24x36" prints) and freestanding contemporary sculpture (tight 12x12" footprint)
fee_reason: Funds juried image processing and secure entry infrastructure. Grand prize winners receive 100% subsidized physical exhibition space on the fair floor + Artsy representation – highly prestigious satellite fair exposure.
questions_approx: Pay first, then upload images + website/Instagram/socials (few fields)
receipts_required: 3-10 high-res images, social links, possibly brief info
includes_entry: Yes for winners (physical fair access via exhibition)
notes: Physical exhibition at Red Dot. Artists handle shipping/printing. Search Google: Black & White Gallery Red Dot Miami open call

title: Nova Gallery Miami Art Week 2026 Online Exhibition
location: Online via Artsy (during Art Basel Miami Beach)
looking_for: Painting, sculpture, photography, mixed media, digital art, conceptual, installation, video, printmaking, textiles, ceramics, drawing, collage, collectible design, new media
fee_reason: Application fee for curator review. Gets you Artsy platform exposure (major collector platform), 70% of net sales, possible non-exclusive representation, press to 75k+ contacts.
questions_approx: Standard form: images, statement, CV, payment
receipts_required: Up to 5 artwork images, artist statement, CV
notes: Online only. Search: Nova Gallery Miami Art Week ArtConnect
